title: Lufia: Curse of the Sinistrals

obj.why: Dialogue portraits are uploaded with every non-zero colour index shifted by 48, into a 256-colour palette built from the font, window and name-plate palettes followed by the portrait's own first 208 colours. Found by matching in-game sprite dumps.

verified.textures: 181 of 223 textures dumped during play reproduced, all pixel-identical
verified.sprites: 324 of 587 sprites dumped during play reproduced, all pixel-identical
verified.backgrounds: not yet checked against in-game dumps
verified.on_device: 2026-09-22, AYN Thor: 37415 entries indexed at game start; 3D textures and sprites render in HD (publisher logos, credits, town) at 60 fps; fades keep the native art

notes: Every asset lives in the indexed archive mcd.dat (mcd_compact.bin + mcd_path.bin), which the tool reads directly.

Not in the ROM, so not in the pack: dialogue text (drawn into sprite memory at runtime), 64x64 bitmap sprites captured from the 3D scene, and character parts the game assembles into one texture. The per-layer filters still apply to those.
HD text: the four 1bpp NFTR fonts in mcd:font/ are packed; dialogue-box text redraws in HD on the Thor (attract demo verified).
